# Daylight Guide Navigation

Bring RestedXP steps, a shared arrow and SPF service searches into Daylight.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- Native active RestedXP steps and targets in a Daylight guide window.
- One shared navigation arrow with manual SPF detours.
- Find vendors, services and mailboxes without leaving the guide workflow.

## Requirements

DaylightUI_ShortestPathForever

## Controls

/fd; /duifind; /spfarrival

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `BaruisaSPFArrival` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.8.2`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/DaylightGuideNavigation/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.
